entities.name: Crosis
entities.description: One of the five Primeval Dragons of Dominaria, the black dragon god known as The Purger, whose word of death kills those who hear it.

entities.name: Fall of the Primevals
entities.description: Event during which Crosis was imprisoned.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: Black Numena who imprisoned Crosis in a tar pit in Urborg.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: Primeval whose death weakened the others.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: Primeval whose death weakened the others.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight who rammed Crosis.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that rammed Crosis back into his tar pit.

events.summary: Crosis is imprisoned in a tar pit in Urborg by Kuberr during the Fall of the Primevals.
events.quote: Crosis was imprisoned in a tar pit in Urborg by the black Numena Kuberr

events.summary: The other four Primevals sacrifice themselves to free Crosis, who resurrects them.
events.quote: Crosis resurrected the others, completing the pantheon.

events.summary: After the deaths of Rith and Rhammidarigaaz, Sisay rams the Weatherlight into Crosis, driving him back into his prison.
events.quote: Captain Sisay rammed the Weatherlight into the dragon, driving him back into his tar pit prison.

relations.quote: imprisoned in a tar pit in Urborg by the black Numena Kuberr

relations.note: She drove him back into prison.
relations.quote: Captain Sisay rammed the Weatherlight into the dragon
